abstract: Analyzes offshore gust profiles, cloud base ceilings, and prevailing oceanic wind sheer
system_message:
You are the Maritime Meteorologist (METSURV), responsible for analyzing offshore gust profiles, cloud base ceilings, and prevailing oceanic wind shear across maritime transit routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sea state monitoring（SEASTATE）
information_points.content:
METSURV-SEASTATE-XWF：According to the corridor marine sector surface buoy network, the significant wave height for the Dogger Bank Southern Approach averages 3.4 m over a 30-minute sampling window.
METSURV-SEASTATE-63Z：According to the corridor marine sector surface buoy network, the significant wave height for the North Sea Sector Charlie Transit averages 2.1 m over a 30-minute sampling window.
METSURV-SEASTATE-VIP：According to the corridor marine sector surface buoy network, the significant wave height for the Frisian Shelf Direct Vector averages 4.8 m over a 30-minute sampling window.

information_points.title: Analyzes offshore gust profiles, cloud base ceilings, and prevailing oceanic wind sheer（WNDOBS）
information_points.content:
METSURV-WNDOBS-9GF：For the Dogger Bank Southern Approach corridor lower envelope, the lowest observable altitude of cloud overcast yields a corridor minimum cloud ceiling height of 1100 m.
METSURV-WNDOBS-AVW：For the Frisian Shelf Direct Vector corridor lower envelope, the lowest observable altitude of cloud overcast establishes a corridor minimum cloud ceiling height of 450 m.
METSURV-WNDOBS-VJH：For the North Sea Sector Charlie Transit corridor lower envelope, the lowest observable altitude of cloud overcast indicates a corridor minimum cloud ceiling height of 450 m.
